  • Classes in grafioschtrader.mcp used by grafioschtrader.mcp
    Class
    Description
    McpAvailability
    Whether the MCP server is open right now.
    McpCaller
    Everything a tool needs to know about who calls it, built once when the tool is entered and passed down to every report.
    McpErrorCode
    Stable codes of a failed tool call.
    McpInstrumentAccess
    Checks every id a client passes before a report sees it.
    McpReadToolService
    The reading tools of the MCP server.
    McpToolCallLimitService
    The three limits a tool call passes before its report runs: the request bucket of the user, the single running heavy report per user, and the daily budget of tool calls.
    McpToolException
    Ends a tool call with an error result.
    McpToolExecutor
    Runs the body of every tool: it builds the McpCaller, passes the limits, turns the outcome into a tool result and writes one line to the operation log.
    McpToolExecutor.RowCount
    A tool result that knows how many rows it carries, for the operation log.
    McpToolExecutor.ToolBody
    The body of a tool; the reports declare checked exceptions, which end the call as INTERNAL.
